# Wuhiufan Skills

> Wuhiufan Skills is a self-operated library of Agent Skills (SKILL.md packages) for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. It sells visual style skills — illustration, explainer video, story animation, news shorts — each reverse-packaged from a real finished output. The starter skill is free; premium skills cost $1.99 each. It is not a marketplace; there are no community uploads. Skills are delivered as ZIP files and run locally in the user's own agent.

## Main pages

- [Home and catalogue](/index.html): what the library is and every skill it offers
- [Pricing](/pricing.html): free starter, $1.99 per premium skill, Creator Toolkit Bundle $39
- [AI info](/facts.html): structured facts about the store

- [News Shorts](/skills/news-shorts.html): verified AI news turned into 20-second vertical shorts, $1.99, in production
- [Pet Holiday Portrait Studio](/skills/pet-holiday-portraits.html): one pet photo turned into nine coordinated studio holiday portraits, $1.99, in production
- [Wuhiufan Press Kit](/skills/wuhiufan-press-kit.html): one article or video turned into cards, long images, WeChat layouts, verbatim editions and video scripts, $1.99, on sale
- [Wuhiufan Human Tone Polish](/skills/wuhiufan-human-tone-polish.html): pre-publishing de-template pass for finished drafts, Chinese and English, $1.99, on sale
- [Wuhiufan Stickman Story Studio](/skills/wuhiufan-stickman-story-studio.html): production discipline for stickman films — character lock, five-beat scripts, narration-led timing, acceptance gate, $1.99, on sale
- [Wuhiufan XHS Launch Kit](/skills/wuhiufan-xhs-launch-kit.html): Xiaohongshu launch and operations kit — positioning, topics, titles, copy, visuals, audits, analytics, $1.99, on sale
